business_summary: In Construction Holdings Limited operates as a contractor in the foundation industry in Hong Kong. The company undertakes foundation works, including demolition, site formation, ground investigation field, and general building works. It is also involved in construction activities. The company serves the building and construction industries. In Construction Holdings Limited was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: In Construction Holdings Limited는 홍콩 기초 산업의 계약자로 운영됩니다. 철거, 부지조성, 지반조사분야, 건축일반공사 등 기초공사를 수행합니다. 건설 활동에도 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 건축 및 건설 산업에 서비스를 제공합니다. In Construction Holdings Limited는 1996년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 코즈웨이 베이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
